data.name: SentItemChannel
data.value: The release channel you use, for example stable.

data.name: SentItemLanguage
data.value: The language of the panel interface.

data.name: SentItemLeaseCredential
data.value: Your licence credential, only when checking whether you may install a module or when asking to download it. Browsing the catalogue never sends it.

data.name: SentItemInstalledModules
data.value: When you check for updates: the id, version and fingerprint of each installed module.

data.name: SentItemNothingElse
data.value: Nothing else: no host name, accounts, sites, users or customer data. Like any web request, it does show the marketplace this server's network address.
